name: Camps Newfound Owatonna
description_short: Christian Science overnight camps on Long Lake in Harrison, Maine: Camp Newfound for girls and Camp Owatonna for boys, ages about 6 to 16, with 2-week to 7-week sessions, trips and a CIT program. The same organization also runs Family Camp and an adult Creative Arts week.

warnings: This page covers several programs. Only the youth Newfound/Owatonna sessions are recorded as sessions. Family Camp 2027 (Week 1 Aug 9-15, Week 2 Aug 16-22; per person: Adult $1,380, Teen 13-17 $1,220, Child 1-12 $850, Infant $400; per-night rates also offered; new families get 50% off Week 2) and Creative Arts 2027 (Aug 24-31, $1,690; Artist-in-Residence $850; registration opens January 2027) are not recorded as sessions.
Cabins with a bathroom cost an extra $200 at Family Camp and Creative Arts.
The 'Next Event' sidebar still shows a 2026 Family Camp event, which is stale. The tuition table is clearly labeled 2027.
The camp says some schedule conflicts may be accommodated by contacting Mary or Reid.
